name: roberts-world
description: Personal plugin marketplace. Ships telegram-durable (a Telegram channel for Claude Code that stores inbound messages on disk before handing them to the session, and replays anything the session missed) and guanling (a per-agent commitment tracker). Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

plugins.name: telegram-durable
plugins.description: Durable Telegram bridge for Claude Code: inbound messages are written to disk before they reach the session, and anything the session never received is replayed on the next start with its original timestamp and a structured replay flag — so a message sent while the session was down is not silently lost. Also surfaces the sender's highlighted quote (message.quote) as its own field, separate from the reply text, plus forward/reply attribution, text_link URLs, and tappable multiple-choice questions (ask_decision). Access control via /telegram-durable:access. Independent fork; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

plugins.name: guanling
